```{r cars}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)   # for str_wrap()

## ===========================
## 0) Order OVO combinations and build readable labels
## ===========================
best.model = fbm[[1]]
combi <- generate_combinations_with_factors(y, X, approch = "ovo")

classes <- sort(unique(as.character(y)))
l_y <- lapply(combi$list_y, function(v) sort(as.character(unique(v))))
ord <- order(
  sapply(l_y, function(v) match(v[1], classes)),
  sapply(l_y, function(v) match(v[2], classes))
)

combi$list_y <- l_y[ord]
if (!is.null(combi$list_X)) combi$list_X <- combi$list_X[ord]

comb_labels <- sapply(combi$list_y, function(v) paste(v, collapse = " vs "))

## ===========================
## 1) Long data: MDA and COEFFS aligned to the same order
## ===========================

## Safety checks (ensure best.model lists have at least as many elements)
stopifnot(
  length(best.model$mda.cv_)   >= length(comb_labels),
  length(best.model$coeffs_)   >= length(comb_labels)
)

mda_list   <- best.model$mda.cv_[ord]
coeff_list <- best.model$coeffs_[ord]

## ---- MDA -> long data frame ----
mda_long <- lapply(seq_along(mda_list), function(i){
  v <- mda_list[[i]]
  if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0) return(NULL)

  data.frame(
    model       = comb_labels[i],
    feature     = names(v),
    importance  = as.numeric(v),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

## ---- COEFFS -> long (sign −1 / +1) ----
coef_long <- lapply(seq_along(coeff_list), function(i){
  v <- coeff_list[[i]]
  if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0) return(NULL)

  data.frame(
    model       = comb_labels[i],
    feature     = names(v),
    coefficient = as.numeric(v),  # -1 / +1
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

## Complete the MDA grid (features missing in a submodel → importance = 0)
all_features <- sort(unique(mda_long$feature))
mda_complete <- tidyr::complete(
  mda_long,
  model   = factor(model, levels = comb_labels),  # fix column order
  feature = all_features,
  fill    = list(importance = 0)
)

## Join the sign; map −1 → "Class A", +1 → "Class B"
mda_complete <- mda_complete %>%
  left_join(coef_long, by = c("model","feature")) %>%
  mutate(
    sign_label = case_when(
      is.na(coefficient) ~ NA_character_,
      coefficient < 0    ~ "Class A",
      TRUE               ~ "Class B"
    ),
    sign_label = factor(sign_label, levels = c("Class A","Class B"))
  )

## Order features by their maximum importance (top first)
feat_order <- mda_complete %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(max_imp = max(importance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(max_imp)) %>%
  pull(feature)

mda_complete <- mda_complete %>%
  mutate(
    feature = factor(feature, levels = rev(feat_order)),
    model   = factor(model,   levels = comb_labels)
  )

## (Optionnel) Si tu veux supprimer les features jamais importantes:
## feat_max <- mda_complete %>%
##   group_by(feature) %>%
##   summarise(max_imp = max(importance), .groups = "drop")
## mda_complete <- mda_complete %>%
##   inner_join(feat_max, by = "feature") %>%
##   dplyr::filter(max_imp > 0) %>%
##   select(-max_imp)

## ===========================
## 2) Taxonomic annotations + facet by phylum
## ===========================
df.annot <- read.table(
  "taxo_hs_9_9_igc_1436_CAG_sup_500_gtdb_214_long.tsv",
  sep = "\t", header = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = ""
)

## Keep row order from mda_complete and add taxonomy
mda_complete.annot <- mda_complete %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df.annot, by = c("feature" = "cag_name"))

## ---- Fix missing phylum / species ----
mda_complete.annot <- mda_complete.annot %>%
  mutate(
    ## if phylum is NA or empty -> "unclassified"
    phylum = ifelse(is.na(phylum) | phylum == "", "unclassified", phylum),
    ## clean species: if NA/empty/"unclassified" -> "unclassified"
    species_clean = ifelse(
      is.na(species) | species == "" | species == "unclassified",
      "unclassified",
      as.character(species)
    )
  )

## Order phyla (so the first one starts at the top, no empty band)
phylum_order <- mda_complete.annot %>%
  distinct(phylum) %>%
  arrange(phylum) %>%
  pull(phylum)

mda_complete.annot <- mda_complete.annot %>%
  mutate(
    phylum = factor(phylum, levels = phylum_order)
  )

## One label per feature (feature: species or feature: unclassified)
feature_labels_df <- mda_complete.annot %>%
  select(feature, species_clean) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    feature    = as.character(feature),
    label_full = ifelse(
      species_clean == "unclassified",
      paste0(feature, ": unclassified"),
      paste(feature, species_clean, sep = ": ")
    )
  )

## Y-axis label function (multi-line)
feature_labeller <- function(x) {
  tmp <- feature_labels_df[match(x, feature_labels_df$feature), ]
  stringr::str_wrap(tmp$label_full, width = 35)
}

## ===========================
## 3) Single heatmap (best model signatures across OVO submodels)
## ===========================
p_top <- ggplot(mda_complete.annot, aes(x = model, y = feature)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = importance), color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = sign_label),
    size = 3.8, stroke = 0, shape = 16,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", name = "MDA | CV") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = "Sign",
    values = c("Class A" = "firebrick1", "Class B" = "deepskyblue1"),
    breaks = c("Class A","Class B"),
    labels = c("Class A","Class B"),
    drop   = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  facet_grid(
    phylum ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",   # free only in y
    space  = "free_y"    # height of each phylum according to number of rows
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = feature_labeller) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 16),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    plot.margin  = ggplot2::margin(t = 10, r = 25, b = 10, l = 30),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_top)

## ===========================
## 4) Auto PDF size (same logic, un peu compact)
## ===========================
n_rows  <- dplyr::n_distinct(mda_complete.annot$feature)
n_phyla <- dplyr::n_distinct(mda_complete.annot$phylum)

#pdf_width  <- 20
#pdf_height <- max(7.5, 5 + 0.12 * n_rows + 0.5 * (n_phyla - 1))
pdf_width  <- 25
pdf_height <- max(
  10,                                # min height
  6 + 0.18 * n_rows + 0.7 * (n_phyla - 1)  # more space per row + per phylum
)

if (requireNamespace("Cairo", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = "heatmap_mda_cv_sign_best_model.pdf",
    plot     = p_top,
    device   = Cairo::cairo_pdf,
    width    = pdf_width,
    height   = pdf_height
  )
} else {
  ggsave(
    filename = "heatmap_mda_cv_sign_best_model.pdf",
    plot     = p_top,
    device   = "pdf",
    width    = pdf_width,
    height   = pdf_height
  )
}
```
